meta.title: Photography Quotation Generator | Studio Suite
meta.description: Build a GST-ready photography quotation in minutes. Function schedule, service catalogue, package tiers and a PDF you can send on WhatsApp. Built for wedding and event studios in Tamil Nadu.
meta.ogDescription: Function schedule, GST breakup, package tiers, instant PDF.

landing.intro: Set up your studio once — logo, address, GSTIN, bank details, signature — and every quotation starts filled in. Add the functions you are shooting, pick services from a catalogue built for wedding photography, and send a GST-correct PDF.
landing.guideIntro: A walk through the quotation generator: the studio profile, the function schedule, the service catalogue, and the three steps from an empty form to a PDF on WhatsApp.

1.title: Your studio, entered once
1.body: Logo, address, phone numbers, GSTIN, PAN, bank account, UPI QR, signature and seal live in a studio profile. Every new quotation starts with them, and the numbering series advances on its own. Run two brands from two profiles.

2.title: Built for weddings
2.body: A function schedule with muhurtham, nichayathartham, valaikaappu and reception already in it. A service catalogue covering candid, traditional, cinematic, drone, LED wall, albums, teasers and reels, each with the right SAC code — and your rates remembered from last time.

3.title: GST done properly
3.body: CGST and SGST within Tamil Nadu, IGST outside it, worked out from the client's GSTIN. A rate-wise GST summary, discounts apportioned back onto the taxable value as the rules require, and the amount in words in lakhs and crores — not millions.

1.title: Set up your studio
1.body: Fill in your details once in Studio Settings. A checklist shows what is still missing, and the GSTIN, PAN and IFSC are checked as you type.

2.title: Build the quotation
2.body: Add the client, the functions with dates and venues, then the services. The preview beside the form updates as you type, and your work is saved as a draft in your browser.

3.title: Send it
3.body: Pick a template, generate the PDF, then download it, print it, email it, or open WhatsApp with a message ready for the client.

1.a: Yes. It charges CGST plus SGST when the place of supply is your own state and IGST when it is not, works that out from the client's GSTIN, groups the tax rate-wise the way a GST document must, and apportions any overall discount back onto the taxable value of each slab rather than knocking it off the total.

2.a: In your own browser. There are no accounts and no server. Your studio profile holds a bank account number and a PAN, so it is encrypted at rest using a key your browser will not let anything export.

3.q: Can I change my studio details later?
3.a: Yes, at any time, and quotations you have already saved keep the details they were created with — a quotation sent in March still renders in October the way the client received it.

4.a: Yes. The interface is available in Tamil, function names carry their Tamil spelling, and a Tamil typeface is embedded in the PDF so the text renders on any machine that opens the file.

5.q: Can I send the same quotation as two or three options?
5.a: Yes. Switch on the package comparison and the quotation shows your tiers side by side, with one marked as recommended.
